theorems.name: Submission.deformation_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η)) ∧ (∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) * X.mass ∧ Y.support = (fun x => ρ • x) '' X.support ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y) ∧ ∀ β : LatticeFaceIndex k N → ℝ, IsLatticeChain 1 β X → IsLatticeChain ρ β Y) ∧ ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (k + 1), (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (k + 1), (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) (k + 1)) x = ρ ^ (k + 1) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) (k + 1)) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → ∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y.boundary ω = X.boundary η
